package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_lazy_loading_eager_load_optional_config: Layer: Lazy loading. Flag optional configuration or metadata loaded at startup before any feature uses it.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
var (
	dashboardConfig  map[string]interface{}
	featureFlags     map[string]bool
	analyticsConfig  map[string]interface{}
)

func scenario555Positive() error {
	// All optional config files are loaded at startup, even if the
	// corresponding features are disabled or never accessed. This
	// bloats startup time and memory for unused configuration.
	for path, target := range map[string]interface{}{
		"config/dashboard.json": &dashboardConfig,
		"config/features.json":  &featureFlags,
		"config/analytics.json": &analyticsConfig,
	} {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, target); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
